Lena R: Quick question from a manager — they want an IC -> manager promotion to take effect 2026-06-01. What's the last day to submit the packet so payroll reflects the new base on that date? @Arjun (People Ops) @Maya (People Ops)
Arjun (People Ops): Hi @Lena R  to get payroll updated for 2026-06-01 submit the full packet by 2026-05-17 EOD PT. That includes manager rec, updated role profile, evidence links, proposed base/OTE, and manager 2-up sign-off. Payroll changes post-deadline become retro pay.
Lena R: If we miss 05/17 and approval lands in late May, can we retro to 06/01 or will finance block it?
Maya (People Ops): We can retro to the requested effective date provided approvals are completed within 90 days. Retro >60 days triggers finance review; >180 days needs exec approval. Always include the requested effective date in the packet so comp-bot marks it.
Jorge (Finance): Confirming Maya. Retro pay is taxed in the period it is paid. Retro >60 days requires additional finance sign-off and will likely process in the next payroll run after approval. Tag payroll row with "PROMO-RETRO".
Lena R: Manager is worried about band ceilings. If the target base would exceed the band, can we use a market adjustment or a one-time cash payment instead?
Arjun (People Ops): Yes, options are: "market adjustment" (one-time, taxed as bonus), "equity refresh" (coordinate with grants team), or phased increase (finance + budget owner approval). For any non-base comp, note the payroll code: COMP-ADJ or EQUITY-REFRESH.
Lena R: For IC->manager conversions, are there extra packets for leadership calibration?
Maya (People Ops): Yes. IC->manager promotions require leadership calibration and a 2-up sign-off. Please attach a direct-reports list, scope doc, and examples of manager-level work. Expect an additional ~5-7 business days for review. If you need a tight effective date, submit earlier.
Lena R: What minimal fields should I include in the promo ticket to avoid back-and-forth?
Arjun (People Ops): Paste this into the ticket body: ```candidate_name: Full Name
current_level: L4
requested_level: L5
effective_date: 2026-06-01
proposed_base: 210000
proposed_ote: 250000
justification_short: promoted to manager of infra services, led migration project, mentors 4 engineers
manager_2up: Name
attached_docs: role_profile.pdf, evidence_links.md, offer_thread_if_any
payroll_code: PROMO or COMP-ADJ
```
comp-bot: Packet created by Lena R  status: 2/6 documents received. Leadership calibration flag set. Auto-scheduled window: 2026-05-20 to 2026-05-22.
Lena R: Thanks  last thing: pre-offer exceptions  if a hire came in above band at offer, do we handle promotions differently?
Maya (People Ops): Include the offer email thread and mark packet "pre-negotiated-comp". Those go to exec comp committee during calibration. Expect additional scrutiny and possible request for budget reallocation.
Jorge (Finance): Also ensure budget owner signs off. If total comp goes above cost-center budget we may ask for phased payments or move to a different cost center.
Lena R: Great, I'll assemble and try to get it in by 05/12 to be safe. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
